about_the_game:
Welcome to the Canis System

Plunge into the chaotic Canis System, where only the sharpest pilots rise to glory. Stars of Strife is a heart-pounding single-player arcade shooter inspired by legends like Galaga, Space War, and Space Invaders. As a rookie mercenary hired by the local government, you’ll battle relentless foes to secure your place among the stars. Crush rebel uprisings, outwit tech-stealing pirates, and face a sinister alien threat lurking in the void. Rack up points, dominate the leaderboards, and etch your name as the galaxy’s deadliest pilot.

Key Features:

  • Arcade-Perfect Controls: Master your ship with pinpoint precision. Dodge bullet barrages, unleash devastating attacks, and weave through chaos to survive.

  • Endless Enemy Waves: Face off against diverse factions, from desperate rebels with stolen weaponry to cunning pirates and a mysterious alien force with cryptic motives.

  • Five Planetary Battlegrounds: Conquer unique missions across five vibrant planets, each culminating in epic boss fights that test your skill and reflexes.

  • Chase High Scores: Compete for galactic glory with a dynamic score system to prove you’re the best.

  • Retro Heart, Modern Soul: Relive arcade classics with stunning visuals, a pulse-pounding soundtrack, and addictive gameplay that’s easy to learn but tough to master.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent (2 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750 (DirectX 11 compatible with 1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300 (3 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 (DirectX 11 compatible with 4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Shoot, dodge, and survive your way through unique bosses and swarms of enemies in this Galaga inspired arcade shooter where the fate of a galaxy rests in your hands.
